title: Nepal Police confirms 626 dead, with district counts updated
body: Nepal Police's 2pm Saturday bulletin says 626 bodies have been found in Nepal. That matches NDRRMA's 10am situation update, while the police bulletin updates the district breakdown: Dhading 49 and Gorkha 54, up from 45 and 48 in the 6am police bulletin.

NDRRMA also lists 2,426 people out of contact in Nepal, up from 1,924 in its Friday evening update. Out of contact does not mean dead. Damaged phones, power and internet still prevent many families from reaching people in the flood zone.

The update says 4,451 people have been rescued and 101 injured people are receiving hospital treatment. It lists 15,224 security personnel deployed for search, rescue and relief, the Kathmandu Post reports.
Nepal Police's new district breakdown sums to 626 bodies: Chitwan 233, Nawalparasi East 158, Gorkha 54, Nawalparasi West 47, Dhading 49, Nuwakot 41, Tanahun 31 and Rasuwa 13.
Keep away from the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli and Narayani riverbanks until officials say it is safe.
